<h1 id="gsmtasks-project-api">GSMTasks Project API v2.4.13</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

The GSMtasks API is a RESTful web service for developers to programmatically interact with GSMtasks data, real-time delivery and task management and route optimization functionality.

# Authentication

* API Key (tokenAuth)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header. Token-based authentication with required prefix "Token"

<h1 id="gsmtasks-project-api-accountroles">account_roles</h1>

<h1 id="gsmtasks-project-api-contactaddressexports">contact_address_exports</h1>

## contact_address_exports_list

<a id="opIdcontact_address_exports_list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/contact_address_exports/ \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /contact_address_exports/`

This view has multiple renderer classes available: `json` and `xlsx`. In order to export the data as an excel file, just set query argument `format` to `xlsx`.When downloading `xlsx` format, use Accept header `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet; version=...`

The user can request what fields and in what order will be rendered using query argument `fields`. This is a comma separated list of field names used in the API.

When exporting to **excel**, the column names may be changed based on pre-defined field names and width mapping.

Available since version 2.2.1

## recurrences_retrieve

<a id="opIdrecurrences_retrieve"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/recurrences/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /recurrences/{id}/`

<h3 id="recurrencesretrieve-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|A UUID string identifying this recurrence.|

```json
  "last_scheduled_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

}
```

## recurrences_update

<a id="opIdrecurrences_update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/recurrences/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "account": "http://example.com",
    "assignee": "http://example.com",
    "is_active": true,
    "order": "http://example.com",
    "rrule": "string",
    "tasks_data": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },
    "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan"
  }'
```

`PUT /recurrences/{id}/`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account": "http://example.com",
  "assignee": "http://example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "order": "http://example.com",
  "rrule": "string",
  "tasks_data": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null
  },
  "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan"
}
```

<h3 id="recurrencesupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|A UUID string identifying this recurrence.|
|body|body|[Recurrence](#schemarecurrence)|true|none|
|» account|body|string(uri)|true|none|
|» assignee|body|string(uri) \| null|false|none|
|» is_active|body|boolean|false|none|
|» order|body|string(uri)|true|none|
|» rrule|body|string|true|none|
|» tasks_data|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» timezone|body|[TimezoneEnum](#schematimezoneenum)|false|none|

```json
  "is_active": true,
  "last_recurred_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "last_scheduled_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

  "tasks_data": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null

  "url": "http://example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="recurrencesupdate-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||[Recurrence](#schemarecurrence)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
tokenAuth
</aside>

## recurrences_partial_update

<a id="opIdrecurrences_partial_update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/recurrences/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}" \
  -d '{
    "account": "http://example.com",
    "assignee": "http://example.com",
    "is_active": true,
    "order": "http://example.com",
    "rrule": "string",
    "tasks_data": {
      "property1": null,
      "property2": null
    },
    "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan"
  }'
```

`PATCH /recurrences/{id}/`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account": "http://example.com",
  "assignee": "http://example.com",
  "is_active": true,
  "order": "http://example.com",
  "rrule": "string",
  "tasks_data": {
    "property1": null,
    "property2": null
  },
  "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan"
}
```

<h3 id="recurrencespartialupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string(uuid)|true|A UUID string identifying this recurrence.|
|body|body|[PatchedRecurrence](#schemapatchedrecurrence)|false|none|
|» account|body|string(uri)|false|none|
|» assignee|body|string(uri) \| null|false|none|
|» is_active|body|boolean|false|none|
|» order|body|string(uri)|false|none|
|» rrule|body|string|false|none|
|» tasks_data|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|object|false|none|
|» timezone|body|[TimezoneEnum](#schematimezoneenum)|false|none|

<h1 id="gsmtasks-project-api-register">register</h1>

## register_create

<a id="opIdregister_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/register/ \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "account": {
      "country_code": "AW",
      "language": {},
      "name": "string",
      "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan",
      "type": "service",
      "website": "string"
    },
    "user": {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "name": "string",
      "password": "string",
      "phone": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /register/`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account": {
    "country_code": "AW",
    "language": {},
    "name": "string",
    "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan",
    "type": "service",
    "website": "string"
  },
  "user": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "name": "string",
    "password": "string",
    "phone": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="registercreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|format|query|string|false|none|
|body|body|[Registration](#schemaregistration)|true|none|
|» account|body|[RegistrationAccount](#schemaregistrationaccount)|true|none|
|» user|body|[RegistrationUser](#schemaregistrationuser)|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|format|json|
|format|xlsx|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "account": {
    "country_code": "AW",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "language": {},
    "name": "string",
    "timezone": "Africa/Abidjan",
    "type": "service",
    "url": "http://example.com",
    "website": "string"
  },
  "token": "string",
  "user": {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
    "name": "string",
    "phone": "string",
    "url": "http://example.com"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="registercreate-responses">Responses</h3>

This operation does not require authentication

<h1 id="gsmtasks-project-api-reports">reports</h1>

## reports_tasks_states_count_retrieve

<a id="opIdreports_tasks_states_count_retrieve"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/reports/tasks/states_count/?account=497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08&date_from=2022-05-24&date_until=2022-05-24' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /reports/tasks/states_count/`

<h1 id="gsmtasks-project-api-taskexports">task_exports</h1>

## task_exports_list

<a id="opIdtask_exports_list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/task_exports/ \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: ${API_KEY}"
```

`GET /task_exports/`

This view has multiple renderer classes available: `json` and `xlsx`. In order to export the data as an excel file, just set query argument `format` to `xlsx`.When downloading `xlsx` format, use Accept header `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet; version=...`

The user can request what fields and in what order will be rendered using query argument `fields`. This is a comma separated list of field names used in the API. Available fields are visible in the example.
Also metafields can be added to the response. For this just add them as fields, using structure `metafields__{metafield.namespace}:{metafield.key}`. 

When exporting to **excel**, the column names may be changed based on account metafield names or pre-defined field name and width mapping.

Changes in version 2.2.1:
 * field names have been updated to reflect the Task fields schema and filters.
 * Invalid fields in fields request will return a ValidationError.
 * Account filter is required.
 * AccountRole display name is annotated to user objects.
 * 'task_event_notes' is dropped.
 * 'contact_phone' and 'contact_email' is replaced with 'contact_phones' and 'contact_emails'.
